description: This file defines the implementation of the Rialto IPC server controller, specifically the ServerControllerImpl class, which manages RPC call failures and client identification within the Rialto IPC framework.

classes.name: ServerControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Rialto IPC server controller, managing RPC failures and client references.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state of the RPC call with a reason string.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC call has been canceled.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC call is canceled.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the client that made the RPC request.
